However, there are notable structural issues: (1) The string instruments are standing upright without visible support (no endpins on ground, no hands), creating a physics violation. (2) The instruments are scaled as cellos/double basses rather than violins, representing a semantic distortion. (3) The spatial relationship between horses and violins is inverted from the prompt. Despite these conceptual errors, the visual fidelity of individual elements (cats' fur, wood grain, dust particles) is excellent. The artifacts are primarily compositional/semantic rather than low-level generation defects like melting or limb fusion.
